authority_source.directive: Cứ tự quyết theo thông lệ kinh doanh thông thường
authority_source.authenticity_note: This records the actual user directive. No personal name, signature, credential, or external approval is fabricated.

conditions: Use only the named isolated non-production target.
Capture a pre-migration backup and checksum before any schema change.
Run migration, read validation, forward repair, rollback, restore, and exact cleanup evidence.
Abort on migration error, checksum mismatch, unsafe data access, failed restore, or failed acceptance test.
Use staging objectives RPO <= 24 hours and RTO <= 4 hours; measure actual local rehearsal results without claiming production capacity.
Keep at least 30 percent measured resource headroom during the rehearsal.
Use synthetic or pseudonymized fixtures only; no real learner, parent, order, or payment data.
Redact identities, tokens, rate keys, secrets, and provider payloads from logs and exports.
Default staging evidence retention is 30 days, followed by verified deletion unless a shorter repository policy applies.
Exports remain access-controlled and release-scoped; deletion and cleanup must be evidenced.
Create dashboards or machine-readable snapshots for availability, 5xx, auth denials, database saturation, queue/backlog, and provider-disabled state.
Use conservative rehearsal alerts: 5xx >= 1 percent for 5 minutes, database utilization >= 80 percent for 10 minutes, or auth failures >= 3x the 15-minute fixture baseline.
Acknowledge simulated critical alerts within 15 minutes and make a rollback or containment decision within 30 minutes.
Run one timed synthetic incident drill and record correlation, escalation, kill-switch, rollback, and recovery evidence.
No plaintext secrets; use environment references or local disposable secret fixtures.
Apply least privilege, deny-by-default access, session revocation, idempotency, replay protection, and fail-closed outage behavior.
Do not expose admin/support inspection publicly and do not weaken existing negative tests.
Record residual risks and block production on any unresolved critical or high finding.
Use mock, fixture, or provider sandbox/test mode only.
No real payment, refund, payout, notification, AI, or other provider mutation.
Require per-provider idempotency, reconciliation, limits, kill switch, rollback, and cleanup evidence before any later live request.
If sandbox credentials are absent, produce a truthful blocker and continue with contract/mock verification only.
The approved scope is limited to the named non-production staging rehearsal.
Production deploy, production database access, live providers, and real-data mutation remain forbidden.
A separate final release decision is required after all rehearsal evidence, blockers, rollback ownership, and residual risks are reviewed.
production_ready and production_enabled must remain false.

resume_condition: Runner may execute one non-production staging-rehearsal slice within these conditions. Any request outside this scope remains blocked.
evidence_required_from_next_job: security and provider sandbox blocker evidence
